structure LockLaws {width : ℕ} (S : EnvelopeSystem width) : Prop where
  invariant : ∀ c, Admissible S c → Admissible S (S.next c)
  rate_antitone : ∀ c, Admissible S c → S.rate (S.next c) ≤ S.rate c
  contracts : ∀ c, Admissible S c → S.error (S.next c) ≤ S.rate c * S.error c

declarations.name: SpectralPolynomialFamily
declarations.statement_text:
structure SpectralPolynomialFamily (Q : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ) (ξ : ℝ)
    (n₀ : ℕ) where
  scale : ℕ → ℝ
  beta : (n : ℕ) → Fin (Q n).natDegree → ℝ
  bound : ℕ → ℝ
  bound_pos : ∀ n, n₀ ≤ n → 0 < bound n
  scale_ne : ∀ n, n₀ ≤ n → scale n ≠ 0
  beta_bounded : ∀ n, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ i, |beta n i| ≤ bound n
  eval_factor : ∀ n, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ x : ℝ,
    evalIntPolynomialReal (Q n) x =
      scale n * ∏ i, (1 + (x - ξ) * beta n i)
